name: Reshmi Kabab
description: Soft Pakistani reshmi kabab made with finely minced chicken, cream, herbs and gentle spices, shaped on skewers and grilled until juicy and fully cooked.
method: Combine the chilled chicken mince with cream, yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chilies, coriander, cumin, white pepper, garam masala and salt.
Add roasted gram flour and mix thoroughly until the mixture becomes sticky enough to hold its shape.
Cover and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
With damp hands, shape the mixture evenly around skewers. Keep the uncooked mixture chilled until ready to cook.
Grill or cook in a lightly oiled grill pan over medium-high heat, turning carefully until browned on all sides and fully cooked. Chicken mince should reach at least 74°C/165°F in the centre.
Rest briefly and serve hot with mint chutney, sliced onion and lemon.
tips: Keep the mixture cold so the soft kababs hold their shape better.
Do not make the kababs excessively thick; even thickness helps the centre cook safely without drying the outside.
storage: Refrigerate cooked kababs promptly for up to 2 days and reheat until piping hot throughout.
